VacancyOverride.title: VacancyOverride
VacancyOverride.description: Cloud-synced override or deletion record for a vacancy/yojana post edited via Word In-Place Edit Mode, shared in real-time across all devices.

vacancyId.description: Canonical vacancy identifier matching the document ID.

isDeleted.description: When true, hides/removes the post across all devices.

title.description: English title summary for auditing and indexing.

titleHi.description: Hindi title summary for auditing and indexing.

payload.description: Native Firestore Map containing sanitized VacancyItem fields edited by admin.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the verified admin who performed the write.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the override document was first created (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private authenticated user profile document isolated by userId.

SavedVacancy.title: SavedVacancy
SavedVacancy.description: User-bookmarked vacancy item owned strictly by userId.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted admin allowlist document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

UserAlertPreferences.title: UserAlertPreferences
UserAlertPreferences.description: Per-user customizable job alert saved searches, notification delivery preferences, and read notification IDs owned strictly by userId.

savedAlerts.description: Up to 25 saved search alert rule objects (keywords, categories, organizations, qualifications, location, minPosts, enabled).

preferences.description: Notification delivery preference settings (inAppEnabled, inAppBannerPopup, browserPushEnabled, digestFrequency, notifyOnStatusChange, quietMode).

readNotificationIds.description: Up to 200 read notification IDs for cross-device unread sync.

JobPost.title: JobPost
JobPost.description: Structured recruitment job post stored in the jobs Firestore collection, mapped directly from PostBuilderClient form fields (Title, Slug, Category, Dates, Links, Description).

jobId.description: Canonical job document ID matching the URL slug.

slug.description: URL-friendly slug generated from the job title.

dates.description: Structured map of important dates (startDate, lastDate, notificationDate, examDate).

links.description: Structured map of official links (applyOnlineUrl, notificationPdfUrl, officialWebsiteUrl).

description.description: Rich text / Markdown detailed description of the job post.

status.description: Publication status (active, upcoming, admit_card_out, result_declared, answer_key_out, closed).

payload.description: Complete VacancyItem native Firestore Map for portal rendering.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the verified admin who saved or updated the job.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the job post was first created (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update.

AdminTemplate.title: AdminTemplate
AdminTemplate.description: Persistent reusable table template configured in the Admin Post Builder (e.g. Result Details with Category, Cut-off Marks, and Download Link).

templateId.description: Canonical template identifier matching the document ID (e.g. result-details).

title.description: English section title for the table template.

titleHi.description: Hindi or display section title for the table template.

content.description: Introductory English description shown above the table.

contentHi.description: Introductory Hindi description shown above the table.

headers.description: Ordered column headers (up to 10 columns, including Category, Cut-off Marks, Download Link).

rows.description: Up to 50 default template row objects ({ cells: string[] }) auto-generated in matching posts.

autoGenerateOnResult.description: Whether to automatically insert this table template on every new result-based post.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the verified admin who saved the template.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the template was first saved (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update.

/jobs/{jobId}.description: Publicly readable, admin-only writable job posts collection managed via PostBuilderClient.

/vacancy_overrides/{vacancyId}.description: Publicly readable, admin-only writable vacancy edits and deletions made via Word In-Place Edit Mode.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profiles accessible only by the owner or verified admin.

/saved_vacancies/{saveId}.description: Per-user saved/bookmarked vacancies restricted to the owning user.

/admins/{userId}.description: Trusted admin UID registry manageable only by bootstrapped or existing verified admins.

/user_alert_preferences/{userId}.description: Owner-scoped saved job search criteria and in-app/browser notification preferences.

/admin_templates/{templateId}.description: Admin-only persistent Post Builder table templates such as Result Details.
